name: hcg-store-web
description: HCG Store — web storefront for Hakmi Capital Group applications and developer tools.

scripts.build: npm run validate:catalogue && tsc -b && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && vite build && node scripts/check-bundle-secrets.mjs dist && npm run server:build
scripts.check: npm run validate:catalogue && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:e2e:full: npm run build && npm run build:fixture && playwright test
scripts.server:build: esbuild server/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/main.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild server/src/auth-evidence-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/auth-evidence.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild server/src/release-records-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/release-records.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild server/src/store-profile-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/store-profile.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild server/src/release-import-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/release-import.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild server/src/free-window-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/free-window.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild server/src/release-exception-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/release-exception.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild server/src/permission-diagnosis-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/permission-diagnosis.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild server/src/with-machine-env.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/with-machine-env.mjs --log-level=warning
